title: Replicated / N-of-M verification
canonical_definition: Support independent recomputation and quorum verification.

roadmap_order.note: CMP-1.4.4 remains open on current main. CMP-1.4.6 is implemented as an independently testable quorum-evidence layer and does not claim signed-verdict completion or contiguous CMP-1.4 completion.

milestone_relationship.rationale: CMP-1.4.6 composes the CMP-1.4.5 independent-selection authority boundary with verifier lifecycle/classes and accepted verification policy, and introduces the first multi-verifier correctness-evidence path. The retained full Compute Market suite is therefore the app-specific Level 2 integration gate.

implementation.committee_rule: Committee is frozen while the job is ACCEPTED and before execution. M is 2..16 and N is 2..M.
implementation.capability_rule: Every member must be the exact ACTIVE verifier revision and hold both INDEPENDENT_VERIFIER and COMMITTEE_VERIFIER capability for the job workload.
implementation.independence_rule: Verifier controllers must be current, distinct from owner/payer/operator controllers and pairwise distinct across committee members.
implementation.recomputation_rule: One immutable vote per committee member after RESULT_COMMITTED. Each vote binds a nonzero result commitment and nonzero recomputation-evidence commitment.
implementation.quorum_rule: Quorum finalizes only when at least N distinct frozen members attest the same nonzero result commitment. Split results do not aggregate.
implementation.authority_rule: Quorum evidence does not submit a verdict, transition the job to VERIFIED, settle, move Vault funds, choose a beneficiary, slash, or grant authority.

authority_boundaries: The selection authority may freeze committee composition but cannot mint verifier identity/capability or bypass controller independence.
Workers/providers/owners/payers/verifiers/outsiders cannot freeze the committee unless they are the separately designated selection authority.
A committee member gets one immutable recomputation vote; duplicate votes and post-finalization votes fail closed.
Suspended/rotated/stale verifier identities cannot contribute new quorum votes.
A quorum on a result is evidence under the frozen policy; it is not itself PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE and does not transition ComputeJobRegistry420.
A quorum result cannot move funds, alter settlement beneficiary/amount, create stake/slash authority, mutate worker lifecycle, govern, bridge, validate, or control wallets.
exit_criteria: A pre-execution committee can be frozen for each job with explicit N-of-M threshold and bounded committee size.
Every committee member is an exact-current ACTIVE verifier with exact independent and committee capability for the workload.
Controller conflicts with owner/payer/operator and pairwise committee controller collisions fail closed.
Only frozen members may submit one recomputation vote each and only after RESULT_COMMITTED.
Quorum requires N distinct members agreeing on the same result commitment; split results and insufficient quorum do not finalize.
Verifier suspension/staleness, duplicate votes, unauthorized voters and post-finalization votes fail closed.
Quorum evidence is domain-separated and bound to exact job, committee, profile and verification-policy provenance.
Level 1 and documented Level 2 exact-head Compute qualification are green.
